# FDG7068

> DO write `default(T)` to the `out` parameter from a Try method that returns `false`.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 7.5.2.1 Value-Producing Try Methods.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: draft

Analyzer candidate rejected: what a method writes to its out parameter on each path that returns false needs data flow analysis.

## From the book

```csharp
public partial class HashSet<T> {
 public bool TryGetValue(T equalValue, out T actualValue) {
   Node node = FindNode(equalValue);
   if (node != null) {
     actualValue = node.Item;
     return true;
   }
   actualValue = default(T);
   return false;
 }
}
```
